items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: I'll say one thing about Teddy McRae, I met him in 1939

ctx.x: So they had the recording in Europe and released it?

Yeah, and it was a big seller. He had this magazine, what they were saying about it and they said they had to leave but they would try their best to get one of those, because I don't know how mine got away--I did have a few, (inaudible) I didn't have a publisher to protect it. Now to show you what it meant by bootleg things sometimes, I tried to talk to some of these youngsters when they say they're going to make a record; I'll say one thing about Teddy McRae, I met him in 1939--is it McRae or McVey?
